description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home!* Only 350 yards to the Beach (access across the street)* Multiple Balconies and Porch Swing* Large Deck andOutdoor Shower* 4 Bikes Included* Steps from 12,000sqft Community Pool* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.***The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. ***We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home.**There is new construction next door.Daze Gone Bye is a spacious 1600sqft, 4t bedroom, 3.5 bath home located in the Seacrest Beach Community, just off Hwy 30A. Only 350 yards to beach access and within walking distance of Rosemary Beach, this fabulous home offers 10' ceilings, hardwood flooring, a bright white kitchen with granite counter tops, and upgraded hardware throughout. With a queen bed in each of the four bedrooms, this lovely Seacrest home sleeps 8 guests comfortably. Chase the sunset from one of the 2nd or 3rd floor balconies, take a dip in the huge community pool or ride the bikes to the beautiful sugar white sands. Come make Daze Gone Bye your family beach tradition for years to come!Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year!The Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedMaster Bedroom: Queen Bed w/ ensuite3rd Floor:Loft Bedroom: Queen BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
